changelog:
- Initial release of the 401k-plan-health skill.
- Enables research on a company's 401(k) plan health using Form 5500-derived data from planprovider.pro.
- Supports provider lookups, plan benchmarking, health evaluation, and meeting prep.
- Data returned includes company, plan stats, provider list, notable signals, and source URL in markdown format.
- Includes guidance on responsible data use and output constraints.
